concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-payment-methods-payto]] — 2026-09-15-captured Australian PayTo overview for account setup, bank mandates, first/subsequent payment and webhook finality, recurring rules and post-transaction handling; source flags setup-enabled and chargeback-label conflicts.
warnings: Setup prose says status success means ready, but example paymentMethod.created has enabled false.
Capability matrix checks chargebacks while disputes prose says no card-style chargeback process and describes manual mandate claims.
Pending/mandate approval is distinct from successful payment notification; bank limits vary and examples do not establish merchant eligibility.
